title: Polynomial-time computability of the determinant algorithm
statement: The function on bit strings that returns the empty string when the integer represented by the first component of the decoded input is less than $2$, and otherwise returns the third component of the state obtained by iterating the determinant-algorithm state transition $(|z|+1)^2$ times from its prescribed initial state, is polynomial-time computable.
